stemMd: If log₃a = 2 and log₃b = −1, what is log₃(a²/b)?
explanationMd: Apply power and quotient rules: log₃(a²/b) = 2log₃a − log₃b = 4 − (−1) = 5. Directly, a = 9 and b = 1/3, so a²/b = 243 = 3⁵.

distractorRationale.c: This combines the exponents without doubling the logarithm of a.
distractorRationale.b: This reverses the division in the logarithm rule.
distractorRationale.a: This ignores the power on a and mishandles the subtraction.
distractorRationale.e: This omits the contribution from dividing by b.
